hook: A clay ink printed at room temperature makes a dielectric for 2D transistors running at 1 volt.
summary: Low-voltage 2D electronics usually need costly atomic layer deposition or high-temperature growth. The authors used a water-based montmorillonite clay ink, applied at room temperature, as the gate dielectric in MoS2 transistors and simple logic circuits and SRAM. Device counts and long-term stability are not given in the abstract.
title: Low-thermal-budget solution-processed montmorillonite dielectric for low-voltage 2D electronics
